The '''Lutrillia system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] in the [[Yarith sector/Legends|Yarith sector]] of the [[Greater Javin/Legends|Greater Javin]] region, located on the [[Lutrillian Cross/Legends|Lutrillian Cross]] [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]]. The system contained [[Lutrillia/Legends|Lutrillia]], [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of the [[Lutrillian/Legends|Lutrillians]].
